title: Figure 12: Lycurgus Cup (British Museum, 4th c. AD) in reflected and transmitted light
description: Two color photographs of the Roman Lycurgus Cup, an ornate glass cup with figures in relief: green in reflected light at left and glowing red in transmitted light at right. The caption reads "Figure 12. Lycurgus Cup (British Museum; fourth century AD). This Roman cup is made of ruby glass." The text explains that gold nanoparticles in the glass act as an early optical metamaterial.
